div.b: The level is a count of replicas

div.span: - ONE waits for 1 replica and is the fastest, at the risk of reading a stale copy. QUORUM waits for 2. ALL waits for all 3 and gives the strongest answer and the weakest availability.

div.span: - Two answers still meet the quorum of 2, so the same SELECT returns rows. CONSISTENCY ALL demands a third answer that cannot arrive, and cqlsh reports NoHostAvailable. Asking for every replica is what turns one lost node into an outage.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 578px; height: 1px; padding-top: 857px; margin-left: 1090px;

display: inline-block; font-size: 13px; font-family: Helvetica; color: var(--ge-adaptive-fg, #000000); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.span: - docker start cass3 brings the third replica back. It catches up with the rows written while it was down, and CONSISTENCY ALL works again.
- The Compose file starts cassandra:4.1.12 three times in datacenter dc1, one rack each, with cass1 as the seed on port 9042.
